# CareGap

> CareGap builds healthcare infrastructure products for companies delivering
> health and wellness services. Products run on HIPAA-compliant infrastructure
> and carry the customer's brand.

## Products

- LabLink (https://caregap.io/lablink, app at https://lablink.caregap.io):
  order Quest Diagnostics lab tests from your own application and receive
  structured results through a single API, with published pricing. Details
  below.
- EasyDonor (https://caregap.io/easydonor): living-donor program software for
  tissue banks and biobanks, covering donor acquisition, eligibility and
  retention. Details below.

More products are in development.

# LabLink

## What LabLink solves

Companies building telehealth, wellness, longevity, peptide and GLP-1 products
routinely need lab testing and discover late that they need a Quest Diagnostics
account, a licensed ordering provider with an NPI, and a HIPAA-compliant place
for the patient record to live. LabLink runs on a live Quest interface and
provides the ordering, results and patient record layer under one agreement.

## Quest relationship and bill types

LabLink works with existing Quest customers and with organizations new to Quest.
Pricing is the same for both, including the onboarding fee.
Every order uses one of three bill types:

- Client Bill: Quest bills the organization's subaccount at Quest's program rates.
- Patient Cash: Quest bills the patient at its standard patient pricing.
  Program rates do not apply.
- Patient Insurance: Quest bills the patient's health plan. Program rates do not
  apply. Insurance details and ICD-10 codes are required.

CareGap provides ordering and results technology. CareGap does not sell, bill or
collect for laboratory testing.

## Pricing (public, indicative)

- Subaccount onboarding: $1,500 one time. NPI and license verification, Quest
  subaccount setup, API keys, sandbox access and BAA. Applies to new and
  existing Quest customers.
- Order platform fee, per order, graduated by monthly volume:
  - Orders 1 to 100: $5.00 each
  - Orders 101 to 500: $3.00 each
  - Orders 501 and above: $2.00 each
  Each order is charged at the rate for its position in the month; earlier
  orders are not repriced. The count resets on the first day of each calendar
  month. Example: 300 orders = (100 x $5.00) + (200 x $3.00) = $1,100.00.
- Patient record: $1.00 per patient, billed annually.

Platform fees apply to every order regardless of bill type. Fees exclude
applicable taxes and are charged to the payment method on file. Final terms are
set in the CareGap Platform Agreement.

## Requirements before ordering

- A licensed ordering provider with an active NPI. CareGap does not originate
  lab orders.
- The CareGap Platform Agreement and BAA, signed before go-live.
- For insurance orders, the patient's insurance details and ICD-10 codes.

## Who it is for

Telehealth, wellness, longevity, peptide, GLP-1 and
other digital health products that need to order lab tests for their patients
from their own app, whether they already have a Quest account or not. Teams
without engineers can have the CareGap build team build and maintain a branded
app or portal on top of LabLink.

## Common questions

- Can I bill insurance? Yes. Use the Patient Insurance bill type; insurance
  details and ICD-10 codes are required.
- Do platform fees apply to insurance and patient cash orders? Yes. Platform
  fees apply to every order regardless of bill type.
- Do existing Quest customers pay onboarding? Yes. The $1,500 onboarding fee
  applies to new and existing Quest customers.
- What does 300 orders in a month cost in platform fees? $1,100.00. 1,000
  orders cost (100 x $5.00) + (400 x $3.00) + (500 x $2.00) = $2,700.00.
- Is at-home collection available? Yes, as an add-on through a mobile
  phlebotomy partner, in addition to Quest patient service centers.

## How to get started

Sign up at https://lablink.caregap.io, or email sales@caregap.io.

## For developers and AI coding agents

The LabLink API is REST, with separate sandbox and production base URLs:
patients, test catalog, requisitions, status, signed webhooks, and a sandbox
playground.

- API docs: https://lablink.caregap.io/docs
- Agent-readable docs: https://lablink.caregap.io/llms.txt
- OpenAPI spec: https://lablink.caregap.io/openapi.json

## Timeline

Sandbox access is available right away. Production typically takes several
business days, because Quest subaccount setup is a manual process on Quest's
side. The integration can be built while that paperwork clears.

# EasyDonor

## What EasyDonor solves

Tissue banks and biobanks working with living donors have to find donors,
screen them against eligibility criteria, consent them, get samples collected
and tested, return results, compensate donors and bring them back, while
keeping records that stand up to review. EasyDonor runs that whole donor
program so the bank can focus on the science.

## How it is sold

CareGap builds a custom donor eligibility program for each bank on the
EasyDonor platform: the bank's eligibility criteria, SOPs, forms, collection
methods, compensation and brand. Pricing is scoped per program; contact
sales@caregap.io or book a demo at https://calendly.com/caregap/caregap-demo.

## Donor portal

- Sign-up and pre-screening questions.
- Health questionnaire scored against the bank's risk factors, with automatic
  deferral.
- Consent signed in the portal and stored as signed PDFs, including HIPAA
  authorization where needed.
- Self-booked eligibility interviews.
- At-home collection kits with tracking and a pre-shipping checklist.
- Blood draws at home through Getlabs mobile phlebotomy or by walk-in at a
  Quest patient service center, with the lab requisition generated
  automatically.
- Lab results visible to the donor only after staff review and release, with
  a referral letter when there is a finding.
- Compensation by e-gift card, tracked thank-you shipments, repeat donations
  by round, and email reminders sent during waking hours in the donor's time
  zone.
- Multiple programs side by side, each with its own steps and compensation.

## Staff console

- Work queue sorted by role (admin, coordinator, scientist, read-only).
- Donor record with eligibility interview, reconfirmation, eligibility
  determination and chain of custody.
- Results review and release.
- Incidental findings workflow with a contact ladder, notification script and
  referral packet.
- Sign-ups opened or closed by program and state; temporary or indefinite
  deferrals per program.
- Kit tracking, lost-kit reports, gift card delivery and resends.
- Funnel analytics, KPI tiles, a cohort explorer and CSV exports.

## Quality and security

- Built for banks working under FDA 21 CFR Part 1271 donor eligibility
  requirements; the bank's own SOPs and forms drive the workflow.
- Records are kept against the form revision they were filed under.
- Audit log of staff actions, multi-factor authentication, automatic logoff
  and enforced password policy.
- Donor eligibility determinations, and responsibility for them, remain with
  the bank.

## Customers

Muse Bio runs its donor program on EasyDonor (https://mycells.bio).
